items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the qualifications for the Information Technology Technician I (Temporary) position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: Education Requirement - One year of education is equal to 30 semester units (45 quarter units). Education must be from an accredited institution. Education used to meet the minimum qualifications must be clearly stated in the application. If using completion of quarter/semester units to meet minimum qualifications, it must be clearly stated in in the Educational section of the application. Missing documentation may result in education not being counted. Options: I have an Associate degree in computer sciences (or closely related field), or an equivalent certificate, AND two (1) year of experience directly related to job duties. | I have two (2) year experience directly related to job duties. | I have a combination of training and/or experience totaling four (4) years that is likely to have provided the required knowledge and abilities. | I do not meet the minimum qualifications listed above.
EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION: An Associate degree in computer sciences or closely related field (or completion of an equivalent certificate program) and one years' experience directly related to job duties;
, two years' experience directly related to job duties;
, a combination of training and/or experience totaling four years that is likely to have provided the required level of knowledge and abilities.

( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.)
Education must be from an accredited institution.

Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment.
